user.title: Where should the forecast be calculated for?
user.description: The aurora oval is a ring around the geomagnetic pole, so what you can see depends on where you are. Christchurch and Auckland get very different answers on the same night.

entity.title: Follow a device or person
entity.description: Pick a device tracker, person or zone. The forecast updates whenever it moves, so it follows you out to a dark sky site.

pin.title: Pick a spot on the map
pin.description: Drag the marker to your viewing location. Handy if you always shoot from somewhere other than home.
